# Objective
The goal of this notebook is to  


# Load the data
The data file is provided in the `data/test_data/` folder.  
The csv file contains one individual per line and several columns, with the column name appearing in the first line of the file.

```{r}
library(readxl)

# Lire le fichier
df <- read_excel("data/DATA.xlsx", skip = 1)

# Enlever les lignes vides
df <- df[!is.na(df$Patient), ]

# Vérifier les noms de colonnes
names(df)

# Convertir les colonnes en numérique
df$SJ_Mean  <- as.numeric(df$SJ_Mean)
df$SJ_SD    <- as.numeric(df$SJ_SD)
df$SJ_CoV   <- as.numeric(df$SJ_CoV)
df$CMJ_Mean <- as.numeric(df$CMJ_Mean)
df$CMJ_SD   <- as.numeric(df$CMJ_SD)
df$CMJ_CoV  <- as.numeric(df$CMJ_CoV)

# Vérifier la structure
str(df)

# Statistiques descriptives
mean(df$SJ_Mean, na.rm = TRUE)
sd(df$SJ_Mean, na.rm = TRUE)

mean(df$CMJ_Mean, na.rm = TRUE)
sd(df$CMJ_Mean, na.rm = TRUE)

# Calcul du Delta
df$Delta <- df$CMJ_Mean - df$SJ_Mean

mean(df$Delta, na.rm = TRUE)
sd(df$Delta, na.rm = TRUE)

# Test t apparié
t.test(df$CMJ_Mean, df$SJ_Mean, paired = TRUE)
```
